thm kernel_is_normal_subgroup:
    ? forall A nonempty_set, mul_A fn(x, y A) A, one_A A, inv_A fn(x A) A, B nonempty_set, mul_B fn(x, y B) B, one_B B, inv_B fn(x B) B, f fn(x A) B:
        $GroupHomomorphismSetting(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, B, mul_B, one_B, inv_B, f)
        =>:
            $is_normal_subgroup(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B})
    claim:
        ? $is_subgroup(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, {candidate A: f(candidate) = one_B})
        release thm homomorphism_maps_identity(A, mul_A, one_A, inv_A, B, mul_B, one_B, inv_B, f)
        release thm set_builder_memb
